question: Why did the error rate go up on 21 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of catalog v3.27 introduced issues with upstream catalog-db.
why_chain: Deployed catalog v3.27 to eu-west (record R014).
The error rate for service catalog increased (record E1).
Upstream catalog-db timed out after retries (records E6, E7).

contributing_factors.description: Increased load on catalog-db due to deployment.
why_chain: The error rate for service catalog increased (record E1).
Request volume for service catalog increased (record E3).
Upstream catalog-db timed out after retries (records E6, E7).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a config_change.
The increase in error rate was due to a data issue.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a data issue.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: The issue is with the upstream catalog-db, not an external service.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to infrastructure issues.
The increase in error rate was due to a known bug.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a known bug.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden spike in users.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume for service catalog did not increase significantly (record E3).

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog rose from 0.42% to 5.47% (+1217%), with a change point at 2026-03-21T15:30:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.06).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog stayed about the same (1704 per 5 min before, 1901 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog rose (120 ms before, 216 ms after, +80%).
Upstream catalog-db returning HTTP 503 for catalog (catalog; 2 min after the change; record R017)
catalog: ERROR upstream catalog-db timeout after 3 retries (catalog, eu-west; 7 min after the change; record R018)
catalog: ERROR upstream catalog-db timeout after 3 retries (catalog, us-east; 17 min after the change; record R019)
Deployed catalog v3.27 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 224 min before the change; record R014)
catalog-db status page: investigating degraded performance (catalog; 30 min after the change; record R021)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (2 min after the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the catalog v3.27 deployment to eu-west.
Monitor catalog-db performance and availability closely.
Optimize the catalog-db to handle the increased load.
